Short answers to your bullets: 
- SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II (in-scope: security & availability) — redacted summary attached. Full report can be shared under NDA; auditor contact: Pinecrest Assurance (auditor@pinecrest-assurance.com).
